name: workflow_run
description:
Execute a workflow by ID. Call workflow_parameters first to discover the required input keys, then call this tool with the workflowId and a fully populated input object.

The workflow starts in a new isolated session and runs in the background. Returns the session ID immediately.

The workflow runner walks the node graph in topological order:
  • parameters nodes  — validate and map the input object onto named workflow parameters ($input.<name>)
  • prompt nodes      — send instructions to the session agent and capture its reply
  • tool nodes        — execute the specified tool with resolved arguments
  • decide nodes      — branch deterministically or ask the agent to choose

To check status or read output, use session_get with the returned session ID.

workflowId.description: ID of the workflow to run (use workflow_list to see available IDs)

input.description: Input values keyed by parameter name, matching the workflow's declared parameters. All required parameters must be present. Check the 'Available Workflows' section in the system prompt for the full parameter list (names, types, required/optional, allowed enum values) for each workflow. Pass {} only if the workflow has no parameters node.

agentId.description: Agent to use for the workflow session. Defaults to the calling agent. Optional.

workdir.description: Working directory for all bash nodes in the workflow. Defaults to the calling session directory.

wait.description: If true, block until the workflow completes and return its summary. Default: false (fire and forget).
